rmh1.review:
Act370 Rmh1 for learning
Ahu for grading.
I did under both
Labiba Hoque ফ্যাকাল্টি যারেই নেন ৩২০ কঠিন আছেই। Rmh1 ভালো। যেকোনোটা আগে করতে পারেন।

মুশফিক সালেহীন Dst ami aksathe korchilam jokhon aksathe amra 320 kori RMH1 sir ar kase 
 But 320 rmh1 and 370 KSR sir hole 2 ta aksathe kora safe but onno faculty hole suggest kori 2 ta aksathe na korar jonno

Go for 320 & 360 rather than 370, if you are ready to give some extra efforts. RBY sir is an amazing faculty for 360 and I would suggest you to go for RMH1 for 320. You can do 370 with another major elective later.

mhcw.review:
Mhcw - vloi porte hobe. Porlei parben. Class gola koiren sir vlo bujhay. Bishesh kore math gola mon diye korben. Mid final er question eto hard kore na.
Quiz er McQ gola easy ii hoy kintu confused hoye jaben majhe majhe eijnno basic ta clear thaka lgbe..
Most important ar minimum 1 grade curve kore. Proyojone 2 grade oo kore. Class performance er upore depend kore ar ki
Zkh1 - super easygoing faculty. Vloi poray kintu lecture shunte shunte ghum Aisha porbe. Ashte ashte ek tale Kotha bole. Course tai easy. Slide oo olpo olpo.
Quiz McQ and case study eksathe ney. Mid final ee short and broad question likhte hoy. Slide porlei easily paben.
Presentation ee kom bolen ar beshi bolen matter na. Fluently confidently bolar try koiren tyle full mark diye dey. Ektu gengen korlei presentation ee mark kom dey jodio tmn Ekta kom na.
Arekta important jinis inbox e koitechi.
